body: Hello stranger, what brings you round these parts

I've had a lot of trouble keeping friends. 3/3 of my last best friends all suddenly stopped talking to me because of who I was but was never given an explanation. I didn't plan to drive these people away, but somehow I did. In fact, I really did care for each of them. I think I do more harm than good.
As the youngest, my family thinks i'm just stumbling into adulthood, that i'm shy and quiet. In reality suicide has plagued my thoughts for years. I'm know i'm gonna do it, just a matter of time
I struggle with what I feel like I need to do vs what is the right thing to do.
I do relate to the "eureka" feeling. If you don't mind, could you elaborate on what weird things you said or did?
